epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #40
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱在海灘上遇到一隻擱淺的大型哺乳動物,擔心牠被卡住,他在少年遊俠的幫助下,用姬蒂的新發明安全地把牠帶回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #41
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲南部森林,嘉豪發現一隻色彩繽紛的孔雀蜘蛛,啟動了一場由少年遊俠展開的混亂救援行動,他們利用彩葉和舞蹈幫助雄蜘蛛求偶,吸引雌蜘蛛注意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #42
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞洲濕地,凱用無人機拍攝了令人驚艷的丹頂鶴,卻不慎將無人機撞入鶴巢。里奧、姬蒂和英雄前往救援,試圖不打擾正在繁殖的鶴,取回無人機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #43
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐西蘭,嘉豪丟失了他的迴力鏢,卻意外遇到一隻迷路、正在尋找巢穴的黃眼企鵝。他呼叫里奧和姬蒂,幫助企鵝找到家並重回家人懷抱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #44
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿拉斯加荒野,傑登、里奧、姬蒂和英雄聯手救援被河水沖走的小灰熊,英雄靠著浮力裝置、穿越急流展現搜救實力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #45
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 竹鯊被困在潮池中,少年遊俠團踏上任務,清理潮池,確保竹鯊順利游回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a bamboo shark stuck inside a tide pool, the rangers head on a mission to ensure the bamboo shark make its way to the sea, even if it takes a tide pool clean up.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about adorable little coochie-coo animal babies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於膽顫心驚的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about thrills and chills.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about play time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animal wrigglers.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who like to hide.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five fliers.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five freakiest animal faces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kooki whips up a rainforest in a jar, then becomes a rock star, jamming on her spectacular cardboard guitar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩學會尊重並善待植物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns to respect and treat the plants well.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一首關於像貓一樣酷的歌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A song about being as cool as a cat!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利擔驚受怕。小孩們將如何幫助比利克服恐懼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy cant stop worrying. How will the children help Billy overcome his fears?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幸運符真的能帶來好運嗎?阿添丟失了他的幸運符,小孩們將發現答案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can a lucky charm really bring good luck? The children find out when Tim loses his lucky charm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇給阿添戴上他無法摘下的面具,將會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Chalky gives Tim a mask that he cant remove?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 下雨會掃興嗎?小孩們想出了即使下雨也能自得其樂的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Will rain dampen the fun? The children figure out how to keep enjoying themselves even though its raining.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和探險家先生必須為叢林音樂節而通過一系列舞蹈測試。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Mr Explorer have to pass a series of dance tests for Jungle Music Festival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添答應讓其他孩子玩他的新玩具賽車。但為何似乎永遠輪不到他們呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim promises to let the other children play with his new toy race car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇從寶拉那裡收到一包彩色粉筆。他非常喜歡,一直在用!這卻造成一些麻煩。小孩們必須協助制止鑿奇,以免他的成癮問題讓事情變得更糟。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chalky receives a pack of coloured chalk from Paula. He loves it so much, he cant stop using it!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利害怕黑暗和很多其他事物,他能面對並克服恐懼嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is scared of the dark and many other things. Will he be able to face his fears and overcome them?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神廟中的一座雕像被偷走,導致叢林發生一些非常不尋常的事情。小孩們能想出將叢林恢復到從前的方法嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A statue is taken from the temple, causing something very unusual to happen to the Jungle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們必須完成貼紙卡,才能贏得神秘獎品。他們很想知道獎品是甚麼,但事實證明收集貼紙比他們想像的要難很多。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children have to complete a sticker card to win a mystery prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添有一隻擁有神奇能力的新寵物。小孩們前往叢林跟牠遊玩。這不單很有趣,甚至啟發小孩們想出一個十分有創意的方法,從探險家先生手中拯救圖騰頭先生!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim has a new pet with amazing abilities. The children head to the Jungle to play with it. Its lots of fun and it even inspires the children to come up with a really creative solution to save Mr Totemhead from Mr Explorer!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們前往叢林,通過與他們的叢林朋友散步來幫助阿添習慣他的新靴。不過,他們當中有人跟不上步伐。甚麼能推動他們繼續前進?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children head to the Jungle to help Tim break in his new boots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謠言在整個遠東村莊傳開,導致友誼破裂。小孩們會怎樣阻止它?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumours are spreading throughout the Far East village and theyre causing friendships to fall apart. What will the children do to put a stop to it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們迫不及待想知道月餅是甚麼,並與遠東村民一起歡度佳節。不過,頑皮二人組妨礙了快樂的慶典。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to win the Best Junior Photographer competition. Does he have the skills to take the winning photo?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想打破蒙著眼接球最多的世界紀錄。找出甚麼或誰在阻止他實現目標。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to break the world record for catching the most number of balls while blindfolded. Find out what or whos stopping him from achieving his goal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇給阿添戴上他無法摘下的面具,將會發生甚麼事?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 下雨會掃興嗎?小孩們想出了即使下雨也能自得其樂的方法。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim promises to let the other children play with his new toy race car.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #20

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Junior Ranger Kyle stumbles upon a flying lizard in the South Indian rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #52
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍與祖米的巡邏行程變成救援行動,因為祖米失蹤,只留下奇怪的笑聲作為線索……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jane and Zumis patrol break turns into a rescue mission when they realize Zumi is missing. Their only clue is a strange laughing sound...

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #53
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在安第斯山,彼由與少年遊俠使用「鴨嘴獸一號」救出一隻被困的幼型南美駝,並用草藥幫助牠找到家人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Andes Mountains, Peyo and the Junior Rangers rescue a trapped chulengo (young guanaco) using PlatypusOne and use herbs to guide it to its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #54
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在高加索山遭遇一隻暴躁的高加索山羊,里奧、姬蒂和英雄展開一場險象環生的山區救援。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah faces danger on Caucasus Mountain, encountering an agitated East Caucasian Tur, leading to a rescue mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #55
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜雨林,彼由發現一隻受困岩縫間的大金龜。里奧、姬蒂和英雄來到現場,幫助牠脫困,並安撫牠的不幸遭遇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Amazon Rainforest, Peyo discovers a Hercules Beetle trapped between rocks, prompting Leo, Katie, and Hero to come to its rescue. After freeing the beetle, its unfortunate day continues, and the rangers try to ease its troubles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #56
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧、姬蒂和英雄趕赴黃石國家公園,救援被卡在懸崖溝谷裡的小水牛和傑登。在一群激動的水牛前,他們要安全將小牛送回原本的群體。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo, Katie, and Hero rush to Yellowstone National Park to rescue Jayden and a distressed baby bison stuck in a ravine. Facing an agitated herd of bison, the rangers must safely reunite the baby bison with its herd.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當有人需要他時,渡渡爺爺總會出現。當孩子們意識到這一點時,爺爺遇到麻煩了,因為即使是最微不足道的事,他們也開始需要爺爺!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Granpa Dodo is always there when someone needs him. When the kids realizae this, he gets into trouble as they start to need him even for the most trivial things!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen shows the kids one of her favourite toys as a child: A trampoline! They all deduce to take turns to use it, but Rita doesnt want to come down and doesnt let anyone else play, so the others decide to force her to come down. But her endless

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比露使用超級生長配方,讓植物(和渡渡鳥)抓狂並失控!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拍檔俠意識到對啫堡俠來說,他只不過是一個小助手。這令拍檔俠重新考慮他的忠誠度,並採用一種新的可怕人格。他將成為……宿敵!他會打敗啫堡俠嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路因為姑毛無法學習新遊戲而感到無聊,所以他讓米娜把他變成更聰明的姑毛。問題是聰明的姑毛反倒厭煩了比路想玩的遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is bored because Goomo is unable to learn new games, so he makes Mina turn him into a smarter Goomo. The problem is that nowGoomo is the one who gets bored playing the games that Bello wants to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場關於牙刷的意外導致公主失去笑容。莉塔很難過,發誓再也不刷牙。她的朋友們會傾盡全力防止這種情況發生,並順道讓公主恢復笑容。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王找到一些舊貼紙,用來表明某人有特殊天賦。比路盡最大努力獲得一張大貼紙,但不幸的是,事情不會像他想像般結束。可能他們會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #58
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南加州沙漠,傑登看到一隻塑膠蜥蜴,後來被公路飛羽帶走。里奧、姬蒂和英雄進行追逐任務,混亂橫越沙漠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Californian desert, Jayden sees a plastic lizard before it is taken by a roadrunner, prompting a mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero to retrieve it, ensuing a chaotic chase across the desert.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #59
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥,彼由與皮可在一個混濁水域遇見一隻缺三條腿的墨西哥招潮魚。他們動員里奧、姬蒂和英雄救援並將當地所有這種魚遷移到更乾淨的區域。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Mexico, Peyo and Pico encounter a three-legged axolotl in a murky lake, prompting a rescue mission for Leo, Katie, and Hero, to relocate all the axolotls in the lake to a cleaner area.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #60
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南美雨林,彼由的國際營地夜遭浣熊偷走他的背包,啟動里奧、姬蒂和英雄尋找背包任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the South American rainforest, Peyos International Campout Night takes a turn when his satchel is stolen by a kinkajou, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to retrieve it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #61
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當傑登在加勒比海撿到一隻被風箏線纏住的鸚哥魚,里奧、姬蒂和英雄啟動任務,在珊瑚礁附近解救受困魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Jayden picks up a discarded kite in the Caribbean Sea, he discovers an entagled parrotfish, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to free the fish near a coral reef.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #62
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲草原,珍和祖米的友誼競賽變危險,祖米被毒性蝰蛇咬傷,緊急救援展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the African grasslands, a friendly race between Jane and Zumi turns perilous when Zumi is bitten by a venomous Puff Adder.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #63
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在中國森林,凱去尋找動物聲音,被蟬鳴吸引。里奧、姬蒂和英雄嘗試幫助孤單蟬找到伴侶,並進行大聲放大蟬鳴的奇妙冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the forests of China, Kai tries to find animal sounds but is sidetracked by a buzzing cicada, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to help the lonely insect find a mate, resulting in a chaotic attempt to amplify the cicadas buzz.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about the super swimmers in animal kingdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 開幕!快開幕!準備好被世上最狂野的魔術師震驚!對!今天的主題是關於動物魔術師和牠們的聰明把戲!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about animal magicians and their clever tricks!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球很危險,如火災和洪水,所以在野外生存需要勇氣。今天的主題全都關於勇敢的野獸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show is all about brave beasts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 希望你不肚餓!因為本集主題包含為動物劣食者準備的令人噁心的晚餐!要吐了!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays show contains disgusting dinners for awful animal eaters! Eeew!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吐比跌得很傷,他的兄弟感到自責。他們開始待吐比很好以作補償。不過,如果吐比對兄弟隱瞞了一個秘密又會怎樣呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Toby has a terrible fall and his brothers feel responsible. They start being very nice to Toby to make up for it. But what if Toby is hiding a secret from his brothers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遠東村角逐「有史以來最佳村莊」獎。他們的確很大機會獲勝,除了一個小問題……實際上是兩個。這兩位村民可以改善自己,還是令整條村輸掉比賽?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Far East Village is up for the Best Village Ever Award. Theyve got a real chance of winning, except for one tiny problem...well 2 actually. Can these 2 villagers improve themselves, or cause the entire village to lose?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曲奇的彩虹玻璃小植物栽培缸來了一位意外的訪客,她用漂亮的毛氈羽翼到處飛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Theres a surprise visitor for Kookis rainbow terrarium and she flutters around in some beautiful felt wings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩很高興從他的朋友海龜那裡學到一首新歌。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho is happy to learn a new song from his friend the Turtle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿上你的舞鞋,準備好與 ZooMoosic 一起跳舞吧!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strap on your dancing shoes and get ready to boogie with ZooMoosic.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #34
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱發現一條被困的大比目魚被沖上岸。在少年遊俠團的幫助下,他們執行營救任務,把這隻大型生物送回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle discovers a large trapped flat fish washed up on shore.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #35
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱發現了一條有奇怪外觀的魚,而一群海鷗過來騷擾牠時,他向少年遊俠團尋求求助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discovers a weird looking fish and asks the Junior Rangers help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #36
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的泥灘探索發現了翻倒的圓尾鱟。少年遊俠能克服恐懼,幫助這些螃蟹華麗轉身嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zaris mudflat exploration leads to the discovery of overturned Mangrove Horseshoe Crabs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #37
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在東南亞海床的探索發現一隻海蜘蛛,促使里奧、姬蒂和英雄的任務是將其從強流中救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs exploration of the Southeast Asian seabed leads to the discovery of a sea spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠團阻止無人機小隊騷擾澳洲可愛的短尾矮袋鼠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers stops a drone squad from harrasing the cute lovable Quokka in Australia.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱與岸邊擱淺的一頭藍鯨幼崽成為朋友,利奧、凱蒂和英雄執行救援任務,將牠帶回公海並與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle befriends a stranded blue whale calf on the shore, prompting a rescue mission.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #40
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱在海灘上遇到一隻擱淺的大型哺乳動物,擔心牠被卡住,他在少年遊俠的幫助下,用姬蒂的新發明安全地把牠帶回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #41
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲南部森林,嘉豪發現一隻色彩繽紛的孔雀蜘蛛,啟動了一場由少年遊俠展開的混亂救援行動,他們利用彩葉和舞蹈幫助雄蜘蛛求偶,吸引雌蜘蛛注意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #42
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞洲濕地,凱用無人機拍攝了令人驚艷的丹頂鶴,卻不慎將無人機撞入鶴巢。里奧、姬蒂和英雄前往救援,試圖不打擾正在繁殖的鶴,取回無人機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #43
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐西蘭,嘉豪丟失了他的迴力鏢,卻意外遇到一隻迷路、正在尋找巢穴的黃眼企鵝。他呼叫里奧和姬蒂,幫助企鵝找到家並重回家人懷抱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #44
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿拉斯加荒野,傑登、里奧、姬蒂和英雄聯手救援被河水沖走的小灰熊,英雄靠著浮力裝置、穿越急流展現搜救實力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #45
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 竹鯊被困在潮池中,少年遊俠團踏上任務,清理潮池,確保竹鯊順利游回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a bamboo shark stuck inside a tide pool, the rangers head on a mission to ensure the bamboo shark make its way to the sea, even if it takes a tide pool clean up.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #46
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在海灘上發現一隻被裝在神祕罐子裡、正在閃閃發光的烏賊。少年遊俠團嘗試開罐,將烏賊遷移到更安全的環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs discovery of a sparkling squid in a mysterious jar on a beach leads the rangers to an attempt in trying to open the jar and relocate the squid to a safer environment.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #47
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當浣熊偷走傑登的通訊器時,少年遊俠展開追蹤任務,設法追回被盜裝置!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路因為姑毛無法學習新遊戲而感到無聊,所以他讓米娜把他變成更聰明的姑毛。問題是聰明的姑毛反倒厭煩了比路想玩的遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is bored because Goomo is unable to learn new games, so he makes Mina turn him into a smarter Goomo. The problem is that nowGoomo is the one who gets bored playing the games that Bello wants to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場關於牙刷的意外導致公主失去笑容。莉塔很難過,發誓再也不刷牙。她的朋友們會傾盡全力防止這種情況發生,並順道讓公主恢復笑容。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王找到一些舊貼紙,用來表明某人有特殊天賦。比路盡最大努力獲得一張大貼紙,但不幸的是,事情不會像他想像般結束。可能他們會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #58
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南加州沙漠,傑登看到一隻塑膠蜥蜴,後來被公路飛羽帶走。里奧、姬蒂和英雄進行追逐任務,混亂橫越沙漠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Californian desert, Jayden sees a plastic lizard before it is taken by a roadrunner, prompting a mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero to retrieve it, ensuing a chaotic chase across the desert.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #59
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥,彼由與皮可在一個混濁水域遇見一隻缺三條腿的墨西哥招潮魚。他們動員里奧、姬蒂和英雄救援並將當地所有這種魚遷移到更乾淨的區域。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Mexico, Peyo and Pico encounter a three-legged axolotl in a murky lake, prompting a rescue mission for Leo, Katie, and Hero, to relocate all the axolotls in the lake to a cleaner area.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #60
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南美雨林,彼由的國際營地夜遭浣熊偷走他的背包,啟動里奧、姬蒂和英雄尋找背包任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the South American rainforest, Peyos International Campout Night takes a turn when his satchel is stolen by a kinkajou, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to retrieve it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #61
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當傑登在加勒比海撿到一隻被風箏線纏住的鸚哥魚,里奧、姬蒂和英雄啟動任務,在珊瑚礁附近解救受困魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Jayden picks up a discarded kite in the Caribbean Sea, he discovers an entagled parrotfish, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to free the fish near a coral reef.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #62
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲草原,珍和祖米的友誼競賽變危險,祖米被毒性蝰蛇咬傷,緊急救援展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the African grasslands, a friendly race between Jane and Zumi turns perilous when Zumi is bitten by a venomous Puff Adder.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #63
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在中國森林,凱去尋找動物聲音,被蟬鳴吸引。里奧、姬蒂和英雄嘗試幫助孤單蟬找到伴侶,並進行大聲放大蟬鳴的奇妙冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the forests of China, Kai tries to find animal sounds but is sidetracked by a buzzing cicada, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to help the lonely insect find a mate, resulting in a chaotic attempt to amplify the cicadas buzz.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔有很多優點,但卻沒有耐性。這就是為何她無法等到床邊故事時間閱讀女王守衛著的書的下一章。她將與比路合作,瘋狂地搶書,並儘快知道故事的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita has a lot of good qualities but patience is not one of them. Thats why shes incappable of waiting until bedtime to read the next chapter of a book the Queen is guarding. The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拍檔俠意識到對啫堡俠來說,他只不過是一個小助手。這令拍檔俠重新考慮他的忠誠度,並採用一種新的可怕人格。他將成為……宿敵!他會打敗啫堡俠嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路因為姑毛無法學習新遊戲而感到無聊,所以他讓米娜把他變成更聰明的姑毛。問題是聰明的姑毛反倒厭煩了比路想玩的遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is bored because Goomo is unable to learn new games, so he makes Mina turn him into a smarter Goomo. The problem is that nowGoomo is the one who gets bored playing the games that Bello wants to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場關於牙刷的意外導致公主失去笑容。莉塔很難過,發誓再也不刷牙。她的朋友們會傾盡全力防止這種情況發生,並順道讓公主恢復笑容。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王找到一些舊貼紙,用來表明某人有特殊天賦。比路盡最大努力獲得一張大貼紙,但不幸的是,事情不會像他想像般結束。可能他們會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花的老同學到訪礁鎮/ 阿燈的幸運貝殼丟在深淵了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash’s old school comes to visit the reef / Dunk’s lucky shell is lost in the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 驚人的大白鯊新聞在當地散播/ 阿燈的朋友們在潮漲時嘗試保護牠的沙畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: News spreads of an impressive great white shark in the area / When the tide comes in, Dunks friends try to protect his sand art.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們相信水花擁有某種超能力/ 阿波感覺自己正努力融入朋友圈。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are convinced that Splash has some sort of superpower / Ripple feels like she is struggling to be part of her group of friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花、阿燈和泡寶試圖幫助一條牠們從未見過的魚/ 水花跟泡寶、阿燈和阿波一起過夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash, Dunk, and Bubbles try to help a fish that they’ve never seen before / Splash joins Bubbles, Dunk, and Ripple for a sleepover.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利擔驚受怕。小孩們將如何幫助比利克服恐懼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy cant stop worrying. How will the children help Billy overcome his fears?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幸運符真的能帶來好運嗎?阿添丟失了他的幸運符,小孩們將發現答案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Can a lucky charm really bring good luck? The children find out when Tim loses his lucky charm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇給阿添戴上他無法摘下的面具,將會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Chalky gives Tim a mask that he cant remove?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 下雨會掃興嗎?小孩們想出了即使下雨也能自得其樂的方法。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Will rain dampen the fun? The children figure out how to keep enjoying themselves even though its raining.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們和探險家先生必須為叢林音樂節而通過一系列舞蹈測試。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children and Mr Explorer have to pass a series of dance tests for Jungle Music Festival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添答應讓其他孩子玩他的新玩具賽車。但為何似乎永遠輪不到他們呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim promises to let the other children play with his new toy race car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鑿奇從寶拉那裡收到一包彩色粉筆。他非常喜歡,一直在用!這卻造成一些麻煩。小孩們必須協助制止鑿奇,以免他的成癮問題讓事情變得更糟。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chalky receives a pack of coloured chalk from Paula. He loves it so much, he cant stop using it!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利害怕黑暗和很多其他事物,他能面對並克服恐懼嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy is scared of the dark and many other things. Will he be able to face his fears and overcome them?

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #34
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱發現一條被困的大比目魚被沖上岸。在少年遊俠團的幫助下,他們執行營救任務,把這隻大型生物送回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle discovers a large trapped flat fish washed up on shore.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #35
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱發現了一條有奇怪外觀的魚,而一群海鷗過來騷擾牠時,他向少年遊俠團尋求求助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discovers a weird looking fish and asks the Junior Rangers help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #36
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的泥灘探索發現了翻倒的圓尾鱟。少年遊俠能克服恐懼,幫助這些螃蟹華麗轉身嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zaris mudflat exploration leads to the discovery of overturned Mangrove Horseshoe Crabs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #37
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在東南亞海床的探索發現一隻海蜘蛛,促使里奧、姬蒂和英雄的任務是將其從強流中救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs exploration of the Southeast Asian seabed leads to the discovery of a sea spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠團阻止無人機小隊騷擾澳洲可愛的短尾矮袋鼠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers stops a drone squad from harrasing the cute lovable Quokka in Australia.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱與岸邊擱淺的一頭藍鯨幼崽成為朋友,利奧、凱蒂和英雄執行救援任務,將牠帶回公海並與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle befriends a stranded blue whale calf on the shore, prompting a rescue mission.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #40
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱在海灘上遇到一隻擱淺的大型哺乳動物,擔心牠被卡住,他在少年遊俠的幫助下,用姬蒂的新發明安全地把牠帶回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #41
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲南部森林,嘉豪發現一隻色彩繽紛的孔雀蜘蛛,啟動了一場由少年遊俠展開的混亂救援行動,他們利用彩葉和舞蹈幫助雄蜘蛛求偶,吸引雌蜘蛛注意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #42
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞洲濕地,凱用無人機拍攝了令人驚艷的丹頂鶴,卻不慎將無人機撞入鶴巢。里奧、姬蒂和英雄前往救援,試圖不打擾正在繁殖的鶴,取回無人機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #43
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐西蘭,嘉豪丟失了他的迴力鏢,卻意外遇到一隻迷路、正在尋找巢穴的黃眼企鵝。他呼叫里奧和姬蒂,幫助企鵝找到家並重回家人懷抱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #44
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿拉斯加荒野,傑登、里奧、姬蒂和英雄聯手救援被河水沖走的小灰熊,英雄靠著浮力裝置、穿越急流展現搜救實力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #45
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 竹鯊被困在潮池中,少年遊俠團踏上任務,清理潮池,確保竹鯊順利游回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a bamboo shark stuck inside a tide pool, the rangers head on a mission to ensure the bamboo shark make its way to the sea, even if it takes a tide pool clean up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物的清潔習慣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the cleaning habits of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物王國裡充滿了不同種類的帶翅膀的生物——這一集是關於它們的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The animal kingdom is filled with different kinds of winged creatures – and this episode is all about them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集被稱為“顛倒的”,這是一個奇怪的奇特節目,一切都不像你想像的那樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is called ‘Topsy Turvy’ it’s a weird peculiar show where nothing is quite as you would think.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這一集講述的是可愛的小動物寶寶以及他們的媽媽和爸爸如何照顧他們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about adorable little coochie-coo animal babies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於膽顫心驚的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about thrills and chills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於遊樂時間的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about play time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於蠕動動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animal wrigglers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於喜歡匿藏的動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animals who like to hide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻來自城市的蟑螂飛到陽光派,史角對自己的小鎮感到羞愧,並羨慕他新朋友的大城市生活。/孩子們在草地上發現一個閃亮的瓶蓋,他們誤以為那是一顆星星,並責怪史角希望它從天上掉下來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a cockroach from the city blows into Sunny Patch, Squirt is embarrassed by his small town and is envious of his new friend’s big city ways./ When the kids find a shiny bottle cap in the meadow, the mistake if for a star and blame Squirt for wish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動作緩慢的蝸牛夏莉進行一場昆蟲偵察遠足,並告訴蜘蛛小姐這班敏捷的蟲群,有時你必須放慢步伐才能注意到特別的事物和朋友。/蹦士和小麻得到一些「魔法」豆豆,讓他們踏上一場非常驚喜的冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Slow-moving Shelley the snail goes on a bug scout hike and teaches Miss Spider’s faster moving bug brood that sometimes you have to slow down to notice special things and special friends./ Bounce and Shimmer get their hands on some “magic” beans that

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜因為莉塔失去了她的房子,所以米娜邀請她的朋友來她家一起住。這種新體驗一開始看起來很有趣,最終卻將成為一個真正的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina losses her house because of Rita, so the little one invites her friend to her house to live with her. This new experience, that seemed so fun at the beginning, will end up being a real challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對女王來說,國王已經變得太依賴渡渡鳥。國王被逼證明他確實是有能力統治的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its become obvious to Queen that the King has become too dependent on the Dodos.A King should be more self-sufficient! So when the Queen expresses her doubts, King is forced to prove that he is, indeed, someone capable of reigning.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是啫堡一個昏暗落雨的下午!孩子們因為不能出去而很難過,所以國王提議一個有趣的活動:輪流講故事。他們將共同創作一個令他們驚喜的故事,甚至將牠們變成……怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路驚訝地聽到國王說施比受更為有福。這怎麼可能?比路竭盡全力證明這一理論。不幸的是,他的嘗試不適用於姑毛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 誰說你不能一心二用?比路會嘗試證明這是可能的,並會在慶祝生日的同時嘗試照顧國王。他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拍檔俠意識到對啫堡俠來說,他只不過是一個小助手。這令拍檔俠重新考慮他的忠誠度,並採用一種新的可怕人格。他將成為……宿敵!他會打敗啫堡俠嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路因為姑毛無法學習新遊戲而感到無聊,所以他讓米娜把他變成更聰明的姑毛。問題是聰明的姑毛反倒厭煩了比路想玩的遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is bored because Goomo is unable to learn new games, so he makes Mina turn him into a smarter Goomo. The problem is that nowGoomo is the one who gets bored playing the games that Bello wants to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場關於牙刷的意外導致公主失去笑容。莉塔很難過,發誓再也不刷牙。她的朋友們會傾盡全力防止這種情況發生,並順道讓公主恢復笑容。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王找到一些舊貼紙,用來表明某人有特殊天賦。比路盡最大努力獲得一張大貼紙,但不幸的是,事情不會像他想像般結束。可能他們會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King finds some old stickers which are used to show that someone has a special talent. Bello will do his best to get a big sticker but unfortunately, things wont end up as he imagined. Or maybe they will.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻來自城市的蟑螂飛到陽光派,史角對自己的小鎮感到羞愧,並羨慕他新朋友的大城市生活。/孩子們在草地上發現一個閃亮的瓶蓋,他們誤以為那是一顆星星,並責怪史角希望它從天上掉下來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a cockroach from the city blows into Sunny Patch, Squirt is embarrassed by his small town and is envious of his new friend’s big city ways./ When the kids find a shiny bottle cap in the meadow, the mistake if for a star and blame Squirt for wish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動作緩慢的蝸牛夏莉進行一場昆蟲偵察遠足,並告訴蜘蛛小姐這班敏捷的蟲群,有時你必須放慢步伐才能注意到特別的事物和朋友。/蹦士和小麻得到一些「魔法」豆豆,讓他們踏上一場非常驚喜的冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Slow-moving Shelley the snail goes on a bug scout hike and teaches Miss Spider’s faster moving bug brood that sometimes you have to slow down to notice special things and special friends./ Bounce and Shimmer get their hands on some “magic” beans that

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #34
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱發現一條被困的大比目魚被沖上岸。在少年遊俠團的幫助下,他們執行營救任務,把這隻大型生物送回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle discovers a large trapped flat fish washed up on shore.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #35
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱發現了一條有奇怪外觀的魚,而一群海鷗過來騷擾牠時,他向少年遊俠團尋求求助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai discovers a weird looking fish and asks the Junior Rangers help.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #36
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利的泥灘探索發現了翻倒的圓尾鱟。少年遊俠能克服恐懼,幫助這些螃蟹華麗轉身嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zaris mudflat exploration leads to the discovery of overturned Mangrove Horseshoe Crabs.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #37
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在東南亞海床的探索發現一隻海蜘蛛,促使里奧、姬蒂和英雄的任務是將其從強流中救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs exploration of the Southeast Asian seabed leads to the discovery of a sea spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #38
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠團阻止無人機小隊騷擾澳洲可愛的短尾矮袋鼠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers stops a drone squad from harrasing the cute lovable Quokka in Australia.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #39
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱與岸邊擱淺的一頭藍鯨幼崽成為朋友,利奧、凱蒂和英雄執行救援任務,將牠帶回公海並與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kyle befriends a stranded blue whale calf on the shore, prompting a rescue mission.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #40
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠凱在海灘上遇到一隻擱淺的大型哺乳動物,擔心牠被卡住,他在少年遊俠的幫助下,用姬蒂的新發明安全地把牠帶回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Kai bumps into a stranded large mammal by the beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #41
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在澳洲南部森林,嘉豪發現一隻色彩繽紛的孔雀蜘蛛,啟動了一場由少年遊俠展開的混亂救援行動,他們利用彩葉和舞蹈幫助雄蜘蛛求偶,吸引雌蜘蛛注意。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Australian Forest, Kyles discovery of a vibrant Peacock Spider prompts a chaotic rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, as they use colorful leaves and dance to assist the male spider in its courtship, to impress a female spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #42
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞洲濕地,凱用無人機拍攝了令人驚艷的丹頂鶴,卻不慎將無人機撞入鶴巢。里奧、姬蒂和英雄前往救援,試圖不打擾正在繁殖的鶴,取回無人機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wetlands of Asia, Kai captures stunning footage of Red-Crowned Cranes before crashing his drone into a crane’s nest. Leo, Katie, and Hero embark on a mission to retrieve the drone without disturbing the nesting crane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #43
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在紐西蘭,嘉豪丟失了他的迴力鏢,卻意外遇到一隻迷路、正在尋找巢穴的黃眼企鵝。他呼叫里奧和姬蒂,幫助企鵝找到家並重回家人懷抱。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, Kyle loses his boomerang but finds a lost Yellow-Eyed Penguin looking for its nest and calls up Leo and Katie to help the penguin find its nest and reunite it with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #44
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿拉斯加荒野,傑登、里奧、姬蒂和英雄聯手救援被河水沖走的小灰熊,英雄靠著浮力裝置、穿越急流展現搜救實力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Alaskan wilderness, Jayden, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue a grizzly bear cub swept away in a river and Hero tests out his search and rescue skills with his flotation device through strong river currents.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #45
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 竹鯊被困在潮池中,少年遊俠團踏上任務,清理潮池,確保竹鯊順利游回大海。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a bamboo shark stuck inside a tide pool, the rangers head on a mission to ensure the bamboo shark make its way to the sea, even if it takes a tide pool clean up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花的老同學到訪礁鎮/ 阿燈的幸運貝殼丟在深淵了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash’s old school comes to visit the reef / Dunk’s lucky shell is lost in the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 驚人的大白鯊新聞在當地散播/ 阿燈的朋友們在潮漲時嘗試保護牠的沙畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: News spreads of an impressive great white shark in the area / When the tide comes in, Dunks friends try to protect his sand art.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們相信水花擁有某種超能力/ 阿波感覺自己正努力融入朋友圈。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are convinced that Splash has some sort of superpower / Ripple feels like she is struggling to be part of her group of friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花、阿燈和泡寶試圖幫助一條牠們從未見過的魚/ 水花跟泡寶、阿燈和阿波一起過夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash, Dunk, and Bubbles try to help a fish that they’ve never seen before / Splash joins Bubbles, Dunk, and Ripple for a sleepover.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當有人需要他時,渡渡爺爺總會出現。當孩子們意識到這一點時,爺爺遇到麻煩了,因為即使是最微不足道的事,他們也開始需要爺爺!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Granpa Dodo is always there when someone needs him. When the kids realizae this, he gets into trouble as they start to need him even for the most trivial things!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們發現展示他們的園藝技能和照顧一種非常特別的植物真的很有趣。不幸的是,要照顧好你需要堅持的東西,這對比路來說是一件非常困難的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids find it really fun to show their skills in gardening and to take care of a very special plant. Unfortunately, to take good care of somethingyou need to be persevering, a very difficult thing for Bello.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔學會了一種新遊戲,而且她非常擅長。重複遊戲。她會一遍又一遍地考驗她所有朋友的耐心。只有一個方法可以讓莉塔明白自己有多煩人,讓她面對銀河系中最好的模仿者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita learns a new game, and she is very good at it. The repetition game. She will try the patience of all her friends over and over. Theres only one option to make Rita understand how tiresome she can be, confront her with the best imitator in the g

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo get into a very challenging project… Designing the perfect toy! A toy that has everything a kid would want, so great that you could never get tired of it. After developing some ideas theyll find out that that object is a lot closer t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the last one to be picked for a team is always hard. But if youconsider yourself as the best player and its you own best friend who doesnt pick you, then its even harder.This is what happens to Bello, and he is not going to take it very well

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王向孩子們展示了她小時候最喜歡的玩具之一:彈床!他們決定輪流玩,但莉塔不想下來也不讓別人玩,所以其他人決定強行讓她下來。但她無窮的精力令她的朋友們備受考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen shows the kids one of her favourite toys as a child: A trampoline! They all deduce to take turns to use it, but Rita doesnt want to come down and doesnt let anyone else play, so the others decide to force her to come down. But her endless

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有人在城堡裡觀看刺激的動畫系列,過得很開心。節目結束後,姑毛決定在電視機前留多一會兒。最後卻在那里留了好幾天!他的朋友們必須想辦法讓他們所認識的那個」活潑有趣的姑毛回來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The group is having a lot of fun in the castle watching an exciting animation series. When the program ends, Goomo decides to stay a little more in front of the TV. And he ends up staying there for days! his friends will have to find a way to bring b

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo win a relay race. The problem comes when they discover that there is only one medal. Who should take the trophy? The argument will lead them to announce the end of their friendship. Luckily the rest of the group will make them see tha

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比露使用超級生長配方,讓植物(和渡渡鳥)抓狂並失控!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In hopes of impressing the Queen with his gardening know-how, Bello uses a super grow formula that makes plants (and a dodo) grow wild and out of control! In taming the wild things Bello comes to understand how plants grow naturally on Jammbo and how

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜想成為啫堡上的萬人迷!她嘗試在啫堡舉辦有史以來最好的派對!當她的四階段樂趣計劃未能為人們實現「最大樂趣」,她學會冷靜下來,並聽取朋友們的意見,瞭解如何讓美好時光發生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina wants to be the go to girl for fun on Jammbo! She tries to create Jammbos best party ever! When her Four Phase Fun Plan fails to achieve Maximum Fun-ness for the group, Mina learns to chill and listen to her friends for ideas on how to get th

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is reluctantly drawn into a mission to help a lost dodo. Rita, with her self-professed knowledge of dodos, only makes matters worse. After a long search, thanks to Minas failed experiment, the dodos parents are lured to their lost babe. And

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo promise to watch over Ritas favourite doll Princess while she goes off to the forest to play with Dodos, but they forget when they go off to play Jellyball. The unattended Princess is scooped up by King who wants to show his kingdom

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo in their super-hero guises Jammboman and Sidekickman create imaginary adventures that bring them face to face with Mina and Ongo who also wish to play super-heroes. The result: an argument about rules governing super hero play. It all

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛認為比路是他最好的朋友。不過,比路也是這樣想嗎?姑毛開始考驗他們的友誼,但不斷的考驗卻適得其反,令雙方都不開心,他們去和「其他朋友」一起玩,但他們發現沒有人比你的死黨更有趣,也更瞭解你的特性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo thinks Bello is his best friend. But, does Bello feel the same about him? Goomo sets out to test their friendship but the constant testing makes Bello run in the opposite direction.Upset with each other, they go off to play with other friends

epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎貓頭鷹和八爪魚來到節目。牠們有相似的視力,並且都有喙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Owl and an Octopus to the show. These animals have similar eyesight and both animals also have beaks!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎企鵝和鷸鴕來到節目。這兩種鳥都不會飛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Penguin and a Kiwi to the show. Both of these birds are flightless.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #15
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎長頸鹿和樹獺來到節目。牠們有相似的口味;認為樹是佳餚!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Giraffe and a Sloth to the show. These animals have similar appetites; they think trees are delicious!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #16
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎老虎和虎甲來到節目。小心!牠們都出了名非常兇猛!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Tiger and a Tiger Beetle to the show. Look out! These animals are known to be very ferocious!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神廟中的一座雕像被偷走,導致叢林發生一些非常不尋常的事情。小孩們能想出將叢林恢復到從前的方法嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A statue is taken from the temple, causing something very unusual to happen to the Jungle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們必須完成貼紙卡,才能贏得神秘獎品。他們很想知道獎品是甚麼,但事實證明收集貼紙比他們想像的要難很多。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children have to complete a sticker card to win a mystery prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添有一隻擁有神奇能力的新寵物。小孩們前往叢林跟牠遊玩。這不單很有趣,甚至啟發小孩們想出一個十分有創意的方法,從探險家先生手中拯救圖騰頭先生!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim has a new pet with amazing abilities. The children head to the Jungle to play with it. Its lots of fun and it even inspires the children to come up with a really creative solution to save Mr Totemhead from Mr Explorer!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們前往叢林,通過與他們的叢林朋友散步來幫助阿添習慣他的新靴。不過,他們當中有人跟不上步伐。甚麼能推動他們繼續前進?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children head to the Jungle to help Tim break in his new boots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謠言在整個遠東村莊傳開,導致友誼破裂。小孩們會怎樣阻止它?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumours are spreading throughout the Far East village and theyre causing friendships to fall apart. What will the children do to put a stop to it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們迫不及待想知道月餅是甚麼,並與遠東村民一起歡度佳節。不過,頑皮二人組妨礙了快樂的慶典。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are eager to find out what a mooncake is and join in the festivities with the Far East villagers. However a mischievous duo get in the way of the happy celebration.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想贏得最佳初級攝影師比賽。他有拍攝獲獎照片的技巧嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to win the Best Junior Photographer competition. Does he have the skills to take the winning photo?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿添想打破蒙著眼接球最多的世界紀錄。找出甚麼或誰在阻止他實現目標。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tim wants to break the world record for catching the most number of balls while blindfolded. Find out what or whos stopping him from achieving his goal.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #46
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在海灘上發現一隻被裝在神祕罐子裡、正在閃閃發光的烏賊。少年遊俠團嘗試開罐,將烏賊遷移到更安全的環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs discovery of a sparkling squid in a mysterious jar on a beach leads the rangers to an attempt in trying to open the jar and relocate the squid to a safer environment.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #47
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當浣熊偷走傑登的通訊器時,少年遊俠展開追蹤任務,設法追回被盜裝置!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a raccoon swipes Jaydens comms device, the Junior Rangers embark on a mission to track the raccoon down and find a way to retrieve the stolen gadget!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #48
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在塔爾沙漠,法拉、里奧、姬蒂和英雄救援一群遭受獵鷹威脅的哈氏棘尾蜥,確保牠們能安心曬太陽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Thar Desert, Farah, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue Hardwickes Spiny-Tailed Lizards from a falcon threat, ensuring the lizards can safely bask in the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #49
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜雨林,少年遊俠展開一場任務:將一對頑皮的小侏儒捲尾猴幼崽送回家與家人重逢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Amazon Rainforest, the Junior Rangers undertake a mission to reunite a pair of mischievous pygmy marmoset younglings with their family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #50
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北美海灘,傑登發現一隻失明的小海豹。里奧、姬蒂和英雄陪同他,觀察小海豹行為,並擔心牠是否與母親走散。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a North American beach, Jayden discovers a blind seal pup. Leo, Katie and Hero join him as they question the pups behaviour and worry if its lost from its mother.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #51
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雨林中,彼由遇見一隻色彩鮮豔的毒箭蛙,啟動一場少年遊俠的救援行動。蛙跳動四散,最後在河邊完成營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the rainforest, Peyos encounter with a vibrant Poison Dart Frog leads to a rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, involving a commotion as the frog jumps around, ultimately culminating in a river rescue

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #52
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍與祖米的巡邏行程變成救援行動,因為祖米失蹤,只留下奇怪的笑聲作為線索……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jane and Zumis patrol break turns into a rescue mission when they realize Zumi is missing. Their only clue is a strange laughing sound...

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #53
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在安第斯山,彼由與少年遊俠使用「鴨嘴獸一號」救出一隻被困的幼型南美駝,並用草藥幫助牠找到家人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Andes Mountains, Peyo and the Junior Rangers rescue a trapped chulengo (young guanaco) using PlatypusOne and use herbs to guide it to its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #54
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在高加索山遭遇一隻暴躁的高加索山羊,里奧、姬蒂和英雄展開一場險象環生的山區救援。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah faces danger on Caucasus Mountain, encountering an agitated East Caucasian Tur, leading to a rescue mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #55
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜雨林,彼由發現一隻受困岩縫間的大金龜。里奧、姬蒂和英雄來到現場,幫助牠脫困,並安撫牠的不幸遭遇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Amazon Rainforest, Peyo discovers a Hercules Beetle trapped between rocks, prompting Leo, Katie, and Hero to come to its rescue. After freeing the beetle, its unfortunate day continues, and the rangers try to ease its troubles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #56
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧、姬蒂和英雄趕赴黃石國家公園,救援被卡在懸崖溝谷裡的小水牛和傑登。在一群激動的水牛前,他們要安全將小牛送回原本的群體。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo, Katie, and Hero rush to Yellowstone National Park to rescue Jayden and a distressed baby bison stuck in a ravine. Facing an agitated herd of bison, the rangers must safely reunite the baby bison with its herd.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #57
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴拉瓜納半島,彼由與皮可發現一隻正在蛻殼的狼蛛,有驚險但和平的「蛻變」任務由里奧、姬蒂和英雄協助觀察。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Paraguana Peninsula, Peyo and Pico finds a tarantula in distress and with Leo, Katie, and Heros help, they learn that the tarantula is molting.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Slow-moving Shelley the snail goes on a bug scout hike and teaches Miss Spider’s faster moving bug brood that sometimes you have to slow down to notice special things and special friends./ Bounce and Shimmer get their hands on some “magic” beans that

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史角和其他蜘蛛兄弟姊妹必須齊心協力,才能爬上許願網,並參觀馬戲團。/酷利感到頭胸痛,唯有讓蜘蛛小姐兼顧每個孩子的活動——她終於明白,無論她有多想,都不可能同時出現在八個不同的地方,而且八隻手也不一定足夠!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Squirt and the rest of the Spider siblings must work together in order to work their way up the wishing web and go to the circus./ When Holley throws out his cephalothorax, it’s up to Miss Spider to juggle each of their kids’ activities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當有人需要他時,渡渡爺爺總會出現。當孩子們意識到這一點時,爺爺遇到麻煩了,因為即使是最微不足道的事,他們也開始需要爺爺!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Granpa Dodo is always there when someone needs him. When the kids realizae this, he gets into trouble as they start to need him even for the most trivial things!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們發現展示他們的園藝技能和照顧一種非常特別的植物真的很有趣。不幸的是,要照顧好你需要堅持的東西,這對比路來說是一件非常困難的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids find it really fun to show their skills in gardening and to take care of a very special plant. Unfortunately, to take good care of somethingyou need to be persevering, a very difficult thing for Bello.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔學會了一種新遊戲,而且她非常擅長。重複遊戲。她會一遍又一遍地考驗她所有朋友的耐心。只有一個方法可以讓莉塔明白自己有多煩人,讓她面對銀河系中最好的模仿者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita learns a new game, and she is very good at it. The repetition game. She will try the patience of all her friends over and over. Theres only one option to make Rita understand how tiresome she can be, confront her with the best imitator in the g

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo get into a very challenging project… Designing the perfect toy! A toy that has everything a kid would want, so great that you could never get tired of it. After developing some ideas theyll find out that that object is a lot closer t

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the last one to be picked for a team is always hard. But if youconsider yourself as the best player and its you own best friend who doesnt pick you, then its even harder.This is what happens to Bello, and he is not going to take it very well

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen shows the kids one of her favourite toys as a child: A trampoline! They all deduce to take turns to use it, but Rita doesnt want to come down and doesnt let anyone else play, so the others decide to force her to come down. But her endless

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The group is having a lot of fun in the castle watching an exciting animation series. When the program ends, Goomo decides to stay a little more in front of the TV. And he ends up staying there for days! his friends will have to find a way to bring b

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo win a relay race. The problem comes when they discover that there is only one medal. Who should take the trophy? The argument will lead them to announce the end of their friendship. Luckily the rest of the group will make them see tha

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina wants to be the go to girl for fun on Jammbo! She tries to create Jammbos best party ever! When her Four Phase Fun Plan fails to achieve Maximum Fun-ness for the group, Mina learns to chill and listen to her friends for ideas on how to get th

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is reluctantly drawn into a mission to help a lost dodo. Rita, with her self-professed knowledge of dodos, only makes matters worse. After a long search, thanks to Minas failed experiment, the dodos parents are lured to their lost babe. And

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo in their super-hero guises Jammboman and Sidekickman create imaginary adventures that bring them face to face with Mina and Ongo who also wish to play super-heroes. The result: an argument about rules governing super hero play. It all

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史角和其他蜘蛛兄弟姊妹必須齊心協力,才能爬上許願網,並參觀馬戲團。/酷利感到頭胸痛,唯有讓蜘蛛小姐兼顧每個孩子的活動——她終於明白,無論她有多想,都不可能同時出現在八個不同的地方,而且八隻手也不一定足夠!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Squirt and the rest of the Spider siblings must work together in order to work their way up the wishing web and go to the circus./ When Holley throws out his cephalothorax, it’s up to Miss Spider to juggle each of their kids’ activities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻在聽完關於騎士保護一朵神秘玫瑰的床邊故事後,嘗試阻止蛛華士採摘陽光派中最美麗的花朵。/陽光派裡有寶藏!一個廢棄的蜂巢。每隻昆蟲翻箱倒籠尋寶,當中包括史角和蹦士。不過,當他們遇到被困在松樹汁中,即將變成化石的蛛華士時,孩子們必須放棄黃金寶藏夢去幫助一隻需要幫助的昆蟲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hearing a bedtime story about Knights protecting a mythical Rose, Shimmer tries to prevent Spiderus from picking the most beautiful flower in Sunny Patch./ There is treasure in Sunny Patch! An abandoned honeycomb. Every bug is looking high and

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #46
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在海灘上發現一隻被裝在神祕罐子裡、正在閃閃發光的烏賊。少年遊俠團嘗試開罐,將烏賊遷移到更安全的環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farahs discovery of a sparkling squid in a mysterious jar on a beach leads the rangers to an attempt in trying to open the jar and relocate the squid to a safer environment.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #47
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當浣熊偷走傑登的通訊器時,少年遊俠展開追蹤任務,設法追回被盜裝置!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a raccoon swipes Jaydens comms device, the Junior Rangers embark on a mission to track the raccoon down and find a way to retrieve the stolen gadget!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #48
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在塔爾沙漠,法拉、里奧、姬蒂和英雄救援一群遭受獵鷹威脅的哈氏棘尾蜥,確保牠們能安心曬太陽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Thar Desert, Farah, Leo, Katie and Hero rescue Hardwickes Spiny-Tailed Lizards from a falcon threat, ensuring the lizards can safely bask in the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #49
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜雨林,少年遊俠展開一場任務:將一對頑皮的小侏儒捲尾猴幼崽送回家與家人重逢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Amazon Rainforest, the Junior Rangers undertake a mission to reunite a pair of mischievous pygmy marmoset younglings with their family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #50
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北美海灘,傑登發現一隻失明的小海豹。里奧、姬蒂和英雄陪同他,觀察小海豹行為,並擔心牠是否與母親走散。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a North American beach, Jayden discovers a blind seal pup. Leo, Katie and Hero join him as they question the pups behaviour and worry if its lost from its mother.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #51
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雨林中,彼由遇見一隻色彩鮮豔的毒箭蛙,啟動一場少年遊俠的救援行動。蛙跳動四散,最後在河邊完成營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the rainforest, Peyos encounter with a vibrant Poison Dart Frog leads to a rescue mission by the Junior Rangers, involving a commotion as the frog jumps around, ultimately culminating in a river rescue

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #52
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍與祖米的巡邏行程變成救援行動,因為祖米失蹤,只留下奇怪的笑聲作為線索……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jane and Zumis patrol break turns into a rescue mission when they realize Zumi is missing. Their only clue is a strange laughing sound...

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #53
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在安第斯山,彼由與少年遊俠使用「鴨嘴獸一號」救出一隻被困的幼型南美駝,並用草藥幫助牠找到家人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Andes Mountains, Peyo and the Junior Rangers rescue a trapped chulengo (young guanaco) using PlatypusOne and use herbs to guide it to its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #54
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉在高加索山遭遇一隻暴躁的高加索山羊,里奧、姬蒂和英雄展開一場險象環生的山區救援。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah faces danger on Caucasus Mountain, encountering an agitated East Caucasian Tur, leading to a rescue mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #55
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜雨林,彼由發現一隻受困岩縫間的大金龜。里奧、姬蒂和英雄來到現場,幫助牠脫困,並安撫牠的不幸遭遇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Amazon Rainforest, Peyo discovers a Hercules Beetle trapped between rocks, prompting Leo, Katie, and Hero to come to its rescue. After freeing the beetle, its unfortunate day continues, and the rangers try to ease its troubles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #56
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧、姬蒂和英雄趕赴黃石國家公園,救援被卡在懸崖溝谷裡的小水牛和傑登。在一群激動的水牛前,他們要安全將小牛送回原本的群體。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo, Katie, and Hero rush to Yellowstone National Park to rescue Jayden and a distressed baby bison stuck in a ravine. Facing an agitated herd of bison, the rangers must safely reunite the baby bison with its herd.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #57
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴拉瓜納半島,彼由與皮可發現一隻正在蛻殼的狼蛛,有驚險但和平的「蛻變」任務由里奧、姬蒂和英雄協助觀察。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Paraguana Peninsula, Peyo and Pico finds a tarantula in distress and with Leo, Katie, and Heros help, they learn that the tarantula is molting.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #13
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎貓頭鷹和八爪魚來到節目。牠們有相似的視力,並且都有喙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Owl and an Octopus to the show. These animals have similar eyesight and both animals also have beaks!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #14
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎企鵝和鷸鴕來到節目。這兩種鳥都不會飛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Penguin and a Kiwi to the show. Both of these birds are flightless.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #15
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎長頸鹿和樹獺來到節目。牠們有相似的口味;認為樹是佳餚!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Giraffe and a Sloth to the show. These animals have similar appetites; they think trees are delicious!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #16
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎老虎和虎甲來到節目。小心!牠們都出了名非常兇猛!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Tiger and a Tiger Beetle to the show. Look out! These animals are known to be very ferocious!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丁文喪妻多年，育有四女玉珍、玉珠、玉珊、玉瑚。性格爽朗的珊與貪吃的瑚，欲撮合顧家的珍與老師崔誠，珊遂吩付男友江清冒充誠致電給珍，可是珍終得知真相，憤而責打珊、瑚。貪玩的珠愛跟富家子夏德玩樂至通宵達旦，終意外懷孕；珍規勸不成，掌摑珠，珠憤然離家出走，唯德拖延婚事，更慫恿珠墮胎。三姊妹尋至珠的公寓，珍與珠冰釋前嫌，並合計設局假裝珠墮胎垂危，令德承認深愛珠，答允婚事。珠回家向父道歉，文亦應允讓二人成婚。
洪熙官與方世玉於少林寺學有所成，官開館廣納徒眾，令惡霸李三爺的武館大受影響，欲剷除官。關公誕當天，官與三爺於會上舞獅競技，雙方大打出手，三爺不敵。其後三爺設宴灌醉官，欲將他殺死，幸玉及時趕至將官救出。
李大鈞挪用了公款，遂命歌女何美玲迷惑少東陳志清，以阻其查核賬目，玲卻愛上清，還說出鈞的勾當。玲的舊情人王七發現鈞屍體，陷害清殺了鈞，但原來鈞沒死，還把七殺掉，更欲殺玲。玲逃命，清與警方趕至，把鈞拘捕。
（續上集）周錦狀告張達窩藏寶靈公主，達女兒寶寶著杯仙救父並令寶靈國王招達為駙馬。錦偷去夜光杯，命杯仙把駙馬府、公主及寶變走，國王限達十日內尋回公主。寶奪回杯，懲治錦和碧珍，卻因洩露杯秘密而與杯仙緣盡。

教員江秋鶩先後邂逅婢女落霞及居於婦女留養院的馮玉如，對兩人留下印象。秋騖是革命份子，警方前往學校搜捕有關人士，幸得落霞報訊，秋鶩成功逃脫，暫避於李教授家中。玉如重遇秋鶩，兩人相處下來，情愫漸生。落霞被逐往婦女留養院與玉如同住，兩人成為好姐妹，落霞更曾救玉如一命。玉如驚悉落霞戀上秋騖，遂毅然讓愛，嫁予別人，豈料其夫為了巴結陸伯清，竟要她侍候清，幸而得到混進清家當副官的秋騖所救；清亦最終被其妻子所殺。

秦淮名妓董小宛傾慕才子冒辟疆甘為妾，但降清明將洪承疇貪戀宛美色，以握有疆反清證據要脅宛就範。疇為保地位將宛獻給順治帝，帝一見傾心欲立宛為妃，宛卻要帝答應奪回政權並殺疇，疇向太后揭發，宛被貶往佛寺病歿。
羅明、白瑩、梁威等人棲身在擠迫的舊樓中，生活貧困。明失業投靠親戚，當起了該舊樓的「收租佬」，被逼追討各人房租，與鄰里反目。颱風來襲，舊樓倒塌，威嫂臨盆在即，明出手相助籌錢及捐血，與眾人冰釋，同舟共濟。
毛不拔無子嗣，欲過繼侄兒之子來承繼財產，毛家三房人遂各出奇謀添丁爭產，鬧出笑話。二侄兒二志無奈訛稱妻子顏如玉有孕，欲以好友之子來頂替，豈料好友誕下女嬰，玉被逼改期添丁。後玉真的懷孕，誕下兩子繼承財產。
黑風寨寨主金清欲將女兒許配予黃天霸，霸砌辭推搪，後來卻另娶張桂蘭。金家不忿，偷取王爺的玉印嫁禍於霸。霸查出一切並成功取回玉印，但他因私放清父女而遭王爺拘禁。蘭等人趕往救霸，並勸服清父女自首，平息風波。
余翰屏誤以為自己醉酒殺人，投河自盡。屏妻王三鳳不信屏已死，喬裝尋夫，時縣官苗九齡出走，其妻秦玉書錯認鳳為齡。屏自殺未遂自首，於是鳳假冒齡查屏殺人案，終水落石出。而鳳與齡原來是失散的孿生姊弟，兩人相認。

黑風寨寨主金清欲將女兒許配予黃天霸，霸砌辭推搪，後來卻另娶張桂蘭。金家不忿，偷取王爺的玉印嫁禍於霸。霸查出一切並成功取回玉印，但他因私放清父女而遭王爺拘禁。蘭等人趕往救霸，並勸服清父女自首，平息風波。
毛不拔無子嗣，欲過繼侄兒之子來承繼財產，毛家三房人遂各出奇謀添丁爭產，鬧出笑話。二侄兒二志無奈訛稱妻子顏如玉有孕，欲以好友之子來頂替，豈料好友誕下女嬰，玉被逼改期添丁。後玉真的懷孕，誕下兩子繼承財產。

李素琴為供弟小強唸書，嫁予劉禮元為妾。元正室劉魏氏與胡文道有染，誣陷琴母殺死婢女，又冤枉琴用邪術殺夫。強與胡家僕人上京申冤，適逢科舉考試，強混入貢院應試，成為小狀元。強重審案件終使真相大白，替母平反。
高慧珠偕母尋親不果，珠母暈倒，幸得周祥福收留二人。富家子黃德昌偶然認識了珠，二人漸生情愫，卻遭昌父阻止。珠母找到已成銀行董事長的丈夫並團聚，時昌父母來借錢，珠趁機戲弄二人，昌父母道歉，珠、昌終成眷屬。
莫生才回港欲繼承叔父的遺產，但其叔父早已身無分文，才惟有與街坊差利找工作，卻處處碰壁。歌舞團班主佐治垂涎團員白雪美色，欲非禮雪，幸差利、才將他趕走。差利等人皆失業，決自組歌舞團，並憑出色表演取得成功。
殷向榮的繼室王丹妮與情人麥深計劃奪產，故陷害榮子可祺入獄，又誣陷可妻江雪貞與可弟兆祺有染。兆含冤，憤而離家，後成為探員並揭發妮與深的陰謀。然而，可對貞誤會甚深，他竟越獄欲殺貞，幸真相大白，一家人冰釋。
捕快金貴公發現惡人曹霸天的罪行，欲往省城揭發他，結果被天追殺而受傷，幸貴公遇上辣椒仔，得他幫忙逃命。其後兩人遇上高人老水魚，獲他相救並被收為徒，貴公更練成睡拳。天終追殺而至，老水魚三師徒合力手刃奸徒。

趙五娘與蔡伯喈夫妻恩愛，喈遵父命上京赴考高中狀元，牛丞相請旨招喈為婿，喈向牛詠嫻坦言不能棄糟糠，嫻深明大義與喈虛鸞假鳳結義兄妹。喈父母旱災餓死，娘行乞上京尋夫，誤會喈薄倖，嫻道明一切，娘與喈夫妻團聚。
歌女楊月容被逼接客而逃走，幸得丁二和收留。容拜師學戲，迷倒宋舜生。和誤會容，讓愛慕和的田二妹有機可乘，與和成婚。曾強姦妹的劉福如欲污辱容，和等人趕往營救，妹遭如踢傷小產，臨終前她祝願和與容能和好如初。
陳美華與會計主任徐日升相戀，華父母卻希望華嫁予富家子汪海澄。升誤會華拜金，華則誤信妹以為升已娶妻，鳳借酒澆愁後險遭澄污辱，幸升趕來相救。陳家向汪家迫婚不遂反被追債，華不計前嫌助陳家解困，華父母終覺醒。
鏢師劉義與助手馮鐵牛從惡霸王五手上救了少女李燕玲，牛與玲後來結成夫婦。五心有不甘，牛與義先後遭伏殺，玲被五捉去，與兒子失散。牛子長大成了幪面俠劫富濟貧，常與五作對，一次救人行動中，他與玲終於母子重逢。
書生柳夢萍與杜麗君有指腹為婚之約，因家道中落，萍偕弟投靠杜家，遭麗父杜守仁冷待。麗夜會萍，稱仁嫌貧愛富，早有悔婚之意，惟她忠貞不二，勸萍勤修苦讀。翌日日間，萍再遇麗，卻被視作陌路，萍不解，後始知麗因被父迫婚已死，日間所見乃麗之孿生妹妹杜婉君。仁迫婉嫁富家子楊耀威，婉欲與萍私奔，惟萍對麗情有獨鍾，寧人鬼相戀而拒絕。萍與弟帶著麗魂魄離開，時婉因不欲嫁威而自縊身亡，麗教萍助己借屍還魂，兩人得成眷屬。

貧困的吳聚財重遇舊同學周日清，清邀財同當經紀為生，成為難兄難弟，還同時愛上鄧秀瑩。財得知清對瑩的心意後，甘願退出，並將佣金送贈二人作結婚之用。瑩提議將金錢來創業，最終清、財合辦「兄弟商店」，共創事業。
賽鬚眉比武招親，賈阿女上台比武，眉妹敏兒使計令眉敗陣。賽父託媒婆向賈家提親，傾心於眉的秦滿天暗中破壞，卻不果。兒偶然結識了正德皇，並拾獲其玉鴛鴦，但其中一隻卻落入天手中，眉姊妹寡不敵眾，兒更遭天擄走。
傅羅卜的後母劉氏為奪家產，與姦夫畢良合謀對付卜。卜弟婦程天嬌發現了二人的姦情，要劉氏聽其使喚。良施計毒害嬌，誣告卜妻趙蘭香是兇手，劉氏不忍香蒙冤竟自首。卜覺可疑，使計令劉氏說出真相，良終得到應有懲罰。

天魔黨首領毛虎為了得到敵對黑手黨的機密，派手下劉奇峰等人夜闖黑手黨要員張月亭家，混亂中峰殺死亭，並嫁禍給黑手黨。密碼專家亭死後，只有其女張愛蘭有解碼方法，故兩黨均逼蘭交出密碼。蘭的男友陳汝霖失蹤多年，突然以黑手黨黨員的身分回來，並助蘭找到亭的日記。可是蘭的阿姨李月娥與峰偷走日記，取去地圖及密碼，更把蘭與霖擄走。黑手黨聞訊前來爭奪，適時警方趕至營救蘭與霖，成功緝拿兩大幫派，此時蘭方知霖是警方的臥底。

張君瑞在普救寺偶遇相國千金崔鶯鶯，一見傾心，特意借寺中西廂來讀書，親近鶯，兩人漸生情愫。一日山賊擄走鶯，瑞獻策救佳人，鶑母許諾將鶯嫁予瑞。危機後，鶯母反悔。侍婢紅娘施計，鶯母終答應讓瑞高中狀元後娶鶯。
張婉薇與關德文被父親安排婚事，但兩人不願盲婚啞嫁拒見對方。其後薇和文意外相遇，兩人一見鍾情，卻不知彼此身分，於是各自找好友王玉玲和李斌代相親，卻讓玲、斌產生誤會。文終發現薇身分，故不再反對父親的安排。

雷翼鵬奉旨偵破金蝴蝶竊案，鵬好友莊德明剛出獄，故嫌疑最大。明女莊靜嫻與鵬子雷紹文相戀，嫻看不過窮人生活困苦，瞞著文化身金蝴蝶劫富濟貧。嫻寄勒索信給城中富豪，逼他們捐款給慈善機構，否則上門竊取。鵬信任明，邀他一起調查金蝴蝶之案件，期間明無意中發現嫻的身分，即前往阻嫻，二人爭辯中，明好友宋成標搶走贓物卻誤觸警鐘被捕。嫻自首，但標欲報答明父女的恩情，甘願代入獄。文與嫻成婚，鵬送上金蝴蝶飾物，盡在不言中。

epg.programme_title_en: Huang Fei Hong Pitted a Lion
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 惡霸石橫與手下作惡，先後被黃飛鴻及江西螳螂派宗師紅眉道人懲治。橫有感二人武藝高強，難以匹敵，故從中挑撥兩派門人自傷殘殺。鴻知悉橫暗中搞局，故率弟子拜會眉，並掀出罪魁橫，一場劍拔弩張的干戈，終化為玉帛。
石秀、楊雄和時遷被逼上梁山，途中投宿祝家店，遷因偷竊被擒，秀與雄逃脫。宋江派秀潛入祝家莊探聽虛實，伺機救遷，又派與祝家教頭鑾廷玉有同門之誼的孫立做內應。時機成熟江率眾攻莊，裡應外合，一舉打敗祝家父子。
周維貢與朱大祥無意中破壞了斬崩刀奪取贓物地圖的計劃，被追蹤。貢、祥被招攬到夜總會工作，認識了歌女唐錦甜。夜總會老闆兩頭蛇逼三人交出地圖，此時刀亦至，雙方大打出手，貢、祥誤打誤撞助警方把歹徒一網打盡。
陳世華已有妻兒任淑娟及國樑，卻戀上梅嘉麗。華決離開妻子，與麗逃往澳門，然而任家令華難以謀生。麗讓華回港投靠樑，華無面目見樑回澳門，麗已不辭而別。兩人一別數載重遇，麗已成為紅伶，華卻潦倒不堪，自慚形穢。
建文帝微服出巡，遇皇子二奎戀人野荼薇，遂帶她回宮。太后欲殺兇殘的奎，帝不忍，只逐奎出關。奎報仇心切，與燕國公主成親後，發兵攻宋，重奪江山。薇為救國，施計盜走玉璽，令奎一敗塗地，傷重而死，薇亦自刎殉情。

三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..

As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.
