epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅.見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮,了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓.並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症.見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河發源于青藏高原,穿越中國雲南省,這是我們旅程的起點.儘管雲南只占中國不到4%的土地,但這裡卻是超過一半的鳥類和哺乳動物的家園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of Chinas land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家族中的雄獅都在探索鄰近的領土時,姆萬巴獅群中的狩獵責任就落在九位強壯的母獅身上.看看她們如何應對雨季的來臨,還要忙於照顧六隻不斷成長且胃口無限的幼獅.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba prides nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流.跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as hes saved from snapping jaws and cements the familys future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在阿曼海岸附近,夏季天氣在海洋深處與阿拉伯陽光的交匯處驅生養分,從而迸發生命.產下較小的魚,水中充滿魚卵.這成了肉食性動物無法抗拒的自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some animals have senses that humans cant even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just cant resist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少地方比索諾蘭沙漠更美麗,更嚴峻.探索風吹沙,高聳的火山峰,並深入外星般的隕石坑.於這個被遺忘的荒野中,缺水的動植物只有適應或者死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Ricas mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證無尾熊瑪拉進行攸關性命的牙科手術,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起評估受傷的滑翔鼠.與獸醫艾麗斯一起從排水溝中救出一隻狐蝠,並看看護士布里孵化的一窩蟒蛇蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵.不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息.然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴關係中古怪而溫馨的愛.深入觀察奇怪的動物,從鼓蝦到鰻狼魚,向牠們的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以確保能一起生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earths oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集正以各種令人驚訝的方式來幫助我們.一隻大丹犬向我們展示如何改變一名13歲的馬薩諸塞州女孩的生活,她只剩有限的生命.一隻隸屬搜索和救援隊的邊境牧羊犬曾經在動物收容所等死,但現在是加州特遣部隊不可或缺的一員,當地震,颶風或致命的泥石流襲擊時負責尋找倖存者.尚比亞的反偷獵犬路格正在檢查走私...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble-both on land and in the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證救援人員如何使用「標記」的技術來追蹤一隻眼睛嚴重發炎的無尾熊,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起照料被燒傷的負鼠.接着跟隨獸醫卡琳娜檢查一隻險些被淹死的鴨嘴獸,再把牠轉介到專科醫生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索老撾甘蒙省壯麗的洞穴,這些位於湄公河和安南山脈之間的天然奇觀,是蝙蝠,壁虎,青蛙和巨型蜈蚣的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少地方比索諾蘭沙漠更美麗,更嚴峻.探索風吹沙,高聳的火山峰,並深入外星般的隕石坑.於這個被遺忘的荒野中,缺水的動植物只有適應或者死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Ricas mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們一起瞭解這三個族群吧:在鬱鬱蔥蔥的中心地帶活動的大型曼茲族群,荒地的卡庫裡族群,以及生活在公園邊緣的小型鸛群.聆聽朱爾茲講述它們在這個成敗攸關的賽季中的勝利和失敗事蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with the three packs: the large Manzi pack in the lush heartland, the Kakuli pack in the Badlands, and the tiny Stork Colony pack living at the parks edge. Follow Julz as he shares their victories and defeats in this make-or-break season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble-both on land and in the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 引導你骨子裡的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇異交配儀式.瞭解為交配而戰,性別偏移和一班加大碼嬰兒為了下一代能有多血腥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證獸醫克萊爾如何盡量滿足生病無尾熊寶寶的需求,以及團隊如何拯救一隻被鐵絲網纏住的滑翔鼠.齊來照顧一隻筋疲力盡的貓頭鷹,並為一隻被車撞的烏龜進行X光檢查,看看結果如何為獸醫蒂姆帶來大驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河沿著泰國東部邊境延伸,塑造了這片土地的地貌,形成數百條穿越叢林的小水道.走進這個巨大網絡之中,窺探恆河猴,大象和狐蝠如何在水邊和諧共處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集正以各種令人驚訝的方式來幫助我們.一隻大丹犬向我們展示如何改變一名13歲的馬薩諸塞州女孩的生活,她只剩有限的生命.一隻隸屬搜索和救援隊的邊境牧羊犬曾經在動物收容所等死,但現在是加州特遣部隊不可或缺的一員,當地震,颶風或致命的泥石流襲擊時負責尋找倖存者.尚比亞的反偷獵犬路格正在檢查走私...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble-both on land and in the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 引導你骨子裡的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇異交配儀式.瞭解為交配而戰,性別偏移和一班加大碼嬰兒為了下一代能有多血腥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證獸醫克萊爾如何盡量滿足生病無尾熊寶寶的需求,以及團隊如何拯救一隻被鐵絲網纏住的滑翔鼠.齊來照顧一隻筋疲力盡的貓頭鷹,並為一隻被車撞的烏龜進行X光檢查,看看結果如何為獸醫蒂姆帶來大驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 氣溫上升意味著水越來越少,並使得大地充滿炎熱感.曼茲族群必須與捕食性動物比鄰而立,依靠剩餘的珍貴水域補充水分.與維卡群一起狩獵,餵養幼崽,並觀察鶴群如何在各種困難中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Wekas pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非雲山上的古老動植物一直引來人們無限遐想.那裡由天氣主宰並受入侵者威脅,但這些山脈不僅是現代生態的避難所,也能讓我們一窺過去旳面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The plants and animals of the Cloud Mountains have long captured our imagination. In a landscape defined by weather and threatened by invaders, see how indigenous forests survive by providing a sanctuary for life while opening a door to the past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上前往斯奈爾斯群島原始荒野的冒險之旅,這裡是一片遠離波濤洶湧大海的動物保護區.在這裡,與斯島黃眉企鵝群一起跳舞,與巨鹱和灰鹱一同翱翔,與巨型海獅一起咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啟程前往新西蘭的奧塔哥半島,這裡是瀕臨滅絕的海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的繁殖地.在這裡,能夠看到海獅,信天翁,紅嘴鷗,白頭燕鷗和仙鋸鹱求偶與繁衍生息的場景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set sail for New Zealands Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭南島的頂部,你會發現一片兩極對立的土地,這裡是世界上最長的沙洲其中之一,吸引著斑尾塍鹬與飢餓的領航鯨,而淹沒的河谷為暗色斑紋海豚和新澳毛皮海獅提供了自助餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入紐西蘭奧克蘭附近的豪拉基灣,探索海洋生物的真正天堂.看一眼深海潛行者蝠鱝,欣賞海豚的搞怪動作,觀賞千變萬化的熱帶魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索紐西蘭北部偏遠群島三王群島的奇異魔力.與寬吻海豚一起游泳,加入短尾黃貂魚的狩獵,感受一群食肉虎鯨出現時的緊張氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往科克群島旅遊,這是3000只座頭鯨準備交配和撫養幼崽的首選目的地.見證巨蚌和綠海龜在島嶼巨大的珊瑚礁中繁衍生息,並一瞥我們的進化歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓.並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症.見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證無尾熊瑪拉進行攸關性命的牙科手術,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起評估受傷的滑翔鼠.與獸醫艾麗斯一起從排水溝中救出一隻狐蝠,並看看護士布里孵化的一窩蟒蛇蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證救援人員如何使用「標記」的技術來追蹤一隻眼睛嚴重發炎的無尾熊,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起照料被燒傷的負鼠.接着跟隨獸醫卡琳娜檢查一隻險些被淹死的鴨嘴獸,再把牠轉介到專科醫生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證獸醫克萊爾如何盡量滿足生病無尾熊寶寶的需求,以及團隊如何拯救一隻被鐵絲網纏住的滑翔鼠.齊來照顧一隻筋疲力盡的貓頭鷹,並為一隻被車撞的烏龜進行X光檢查,看看結果如何為獸醫蒂姆帶來大驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人.和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部野生動物紀錄片探索了被稱為珊德維爾德的西部與海岸.通過茂密的陸地植被和穿越苛刻的開放空間,又在水底下穿梭,在土地的並置中有甚麼生存條件呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A narrow and harsh belt of western coastline in southern Africa is a land of contrasts where creatures are forced to adapt to survive. Meet the quirky and charismatic inhabitants that call this fragile interplay between land and ocean home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春回大地,農場裡生機處處.雙胞胎羔羊拿利和科嬅,以及其他新生兒在草地上歡騰.小牛孤兒莫莉努力生活,而母豬姬絲則有一位情人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季意味著動物可以在空曠的草地上漫遊,也導致了海福特牛群的不和,還有黃牛間的戰鬥.赫布里底羊進行逃脫,倒霉的牧羊犬謝茜有了第一次驅攏的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河發源于青藏高原,穿越中國雲南省,這是我們旅程的起點.儘管雲南只占中國不到4%的土地,但這裡卻是超過一半的鳥類和哺乳動物的家園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of Chinas land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索老撾甘蒙省壯麗的洞穴,這些位於湄公河和安南山脈之間的天然奇觀,是蝙蝠,壁虎,青蛙和巨型蜈蚣的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河沿著泰國東部邊境延伸,塑造了這片土地的地貌,形成數百條穿越叢林的小水道.走進這個巨大網絡之中,窺探恆河猴,大象和狐蝠如何在水邊和諧共處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jarrad Howse takes Chill to the hidden surf destination of Tofino in Canada. Cold, humid and windy, but better still, a sublime surf! We meet the Pro's of the Cold Water Classic.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jarrad Howse takes Chill to the hidden surf destination of Tofino in Canada. Cold, humid and windy, but better still, a sublime surf! We meet the Pro's of the Cold Water Classic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sally Fitzgibbons takes us surfing in California. The South African Tatjana Schoenmaker makes waves at the Commonwealth Games.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sally Fitzgibbons takes us surfing in California. The South African Tatjana Schoenmaker makes waves at the Commonwealth Games.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Argentina: cradle of Maradona, Messi and an uncompromising footballing culture.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Argentina: cradle of Maradona, Messi and an uncompromising footballing culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Italy can be counted among the most impassioned and significant footballing nations.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italy can be counted among the most impassioned and significant footballing nations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Saudi Arabia is in the process of becoming a powerful new actor on the global footballing scene.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Saudi Arabia is in the process of becoming a powerful new actor on the global footballing scene.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Western region is the motor force of African football.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Western region is the motor force of African football.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: CONMEBOL is on the verge of becoming the first confederation all of whose members have participated in a World Cup.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CONMEBOL is on the verge of becoming the first confederation all of whose members have participated in a World Cup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brazil is the footballing nation par excellence.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Brazil is the footballing nation par excellence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The eight year suspension for doping of swimmer Sun Yang, the USA's Ryan Lochte is unmasked in Rio and the Australian Dawn Fraser hunts for memories at Tokyo 1964.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The eight year suspension for doping of swimmer Sun Yang, the USA's Ryan Lochte is unmasked in Rio and the Australian Dawn Fraser hunts for memories at Tokyo 1964.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Portugal is a historic footballing nation and now a factory for the football elite.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal is a historic footballing nation and now a factory for the football elite.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: For some decades, F1 has been an elite competition where technology and performance are pushed to the limits of the possible. But the biggest challenge faced by F1 today is to become sustainable.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For some decades, F1 has been an elite competition where technology and performance are pushed to the limits of the possible. But the biggest challenge faced by F1 today is to become sustainable.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Chill heads to the antipodes to do some water skiing with the men's Action Tricks Comp and the women's Ski Jump. We examine in detail the women's longboard championships in the South China sea.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chill heads to the antipodes to do some water skiing with the men's Action Tricks Comp and the women's Ski Jump. We examine in detail the women's longboard championships in the South China sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Since Marta erupted on the football field, she has proved that she can do what the men do, and the Laureus World Sports Awards present some of the most inspiring athletes in the world….
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Since Marta erupted on the football field, she has proved that she can do what the men do, and the Laureus World Sports Awards present some of the most inspiring athletes in the world….

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Uruguay was the most important football nation at the beginning of the 20th century.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uruguay was the most important football nation at the beginning of the 20th century.

Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

If you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the heart of London, Inspector Callum Isitt teams up with the police to track down four dogs, including two St Bernard types that have allegedly been beaten by their owners.  One trail leads Callum to bustling Parliament Square, where it’s believed the St Bernard types are being used to get passers-by to part with their cash. Will he manage to find the dogs that he is looking for?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to 『talk』 to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examining nature’s most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Showcasing some of nature’s most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造,徵服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營,回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴,跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆克魯斯的特技指導韋德伊士活,《勇者無敵》聯合主演比利範贊,《夜訪吸血鬼》製作人史蒂芬胡利等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Cruise’s stunt coordinator Wade Eastwood, Taps co-star Billy Van Zandt, Interview With The Vampire producer Stephen Woolley, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界--這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades. A true pioneer, she’s dominated music charts, reinvented herself in film, and built a legacy that transce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影.他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影.他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 米高 J 福克斯:演員樂觀活動家
epg.programme_title_en: Michael J. Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米高J霍士的一生,從成名到29歲被診斷出患上帕金遜症,就像一部真人秀電影,充滿了意想不到的轉折和顯著的韌性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael J. Foxs life, from his rise to fame to a Parkinsons diagnosis at 29, has been nothing short of a real-life movie, marked by unexpected twists and remarkable resilience.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: P!nk 是流行與搖滾樂壇的強大存在.雖然她最初被視為九○年代末眾多青少年流行歌手之一,但她最終開創了屬於自己的音樂風格,並穩固了無可取代的地位.她,是當今樂壇不可忽視的力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90’s crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be r

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞臺--凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想,歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事.這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇--從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world - Carrie Underwood’s journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn’t be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood - the all-American girl who bec

epg.programme_title_tc: 海倫米蘭:舞臺與銀幕的女王
epg.programme_title_en: Helen Mirren: Queen Of Stage And Screen
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片深入探討 Helen Mirren 無畏的演藝生涯,追溯她從平凡出身到成為全球巨星的旅程,涵蓋她在劇場的早期成就,以及橫跨電影與電視的多元角色表現.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Helen Mirren’s fearless career, tracing her journey from a humble upbringing to becoming a global icon. It covers her early successes in the world of theatre as well as her wide range of film and television roles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 妮可基嫚: 走向奧斯卡
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活,電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏.從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feature documentary about the early life, filmic career, and trials and tribulations of Australian icon, Nicole Kidman. From a Bush Christmas to Oscar winning performances, her story is one of inspiration and hardship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時......有一個名字脫穎而出.從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報......這就是小勞勃道尼
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood... A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution... This is Robert Downey Jr.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as 『America’s Nice Guy』, 』The Everyman』 and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造,徵服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營,回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴,跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨澳洲主廚馬西莫·梅勒在《大廚的後花園》中探索塔斯馬尼亞的鮮美在地食材.從自製義大利土豆糰子(Gnocchi)到野生鮑魚,一同發現他最愛的食譜,展現這座島嶼豐富的飲食寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Australian chef Massimo Mele as he explores Tasmanias fresh local produce in The Chefs Garden. Discover his favorite recipes, from homemade Italian gnocchi to fresh ocean abalone, highlighting the islands rich culinary treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬西莫走訪工廠與農田,揭開塔斯馬尼亞起司,橄欖與農園新鮮作物的美味秘訣.隨後,他展現高超廚藝,打造出從前菜到麵食的三道精緻義式佳餚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massimo visits factories and farmlands to reveal the secrets behind Tasmanian cheeses, olives, and garden-fresh produce. He then demonstrates his culinary skills by making three delicious Italian dishes, from appetizers to pasta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主廚馬西莫·梅勒深入探尋塔斯馬尼亞頂級在地食材,包括備受推崇的放牧豬肉香菇香腸與現採新鮮蘑菇.一路上,他烹調出令人垂涎的柴燒披薩與自製手捲麵(Cavatelli).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chef Massimo Mele explores Tassies finest local ingredients, including prized free-range pork sausages and freshly picked mushrooms. Along the way, he cooks mouthwatering recipes like wood-fired pizza and homemade cavatelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬西莫將彤戈拉(Tongola)山羊奶起司與新鮮農園甜菜根及蔬菜搭配,完美展現從農場到餐桌的飲食理念.接著,他與在地農夫一同潛入清澈的塔斯馬尼亞海域,品嚐世界上最優質的生蠔.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massimo showcases farm-to-table dining by pairing Tongola goat curd with fresh garden beetroot and vegetables. He then heads into clear Tasmanian waters with local farmers to sample some of the finest oysters in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本季最終集,馬西莫與漁夫布萊恩·丹尼出海,捕撈珍貴的南部巖石龍子.最後,他精心準備了兩道深受家族喜愛的甜點--義式奶凍(Panna Cotta)與義式炸甜甜圈(Zeppole),為這趟美食冒險畫下甜蜜句點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the season finale, Massimo sails with fisherman Bryan Denny to catch prized Southern Rock Lobster. He completes his culinary adventure on a sweet note by preparing two cherished family favorites: panna cotta and zeppole.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨澳洲主廚馬西莫·梅勒在《大廚的後花園》中探索塔斯馬尼亞的鮮美在地食材.從自製義大利土豆糰子(Gnocchi)到野生鮑魚,一同發現他最愛的食譜,展現這座島嶼豐富的飲食寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Australian chef Massimo Mele as he explores Tasmanias fresh local produce in The Chefs Garden. Discover his favorite recipes, from homemade Italian gnocchi to fresh ocean abalone, highlighting the islands rich culinary treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as 「The Iron Butterfly」 - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造,徵服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營,回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴,跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨澳洲主廚馬西莫·梅勒在《大廚的後花園》中探索塔斯馬尼亞的鮮美在地食材.從自製義大利土豆糰子(Gnocchi)到野生鮑魚,一同發現他最愛的食譜,展現這座島嶼豐富的飲食寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Australian chef Massimo Mele as he explores Tasmanias fresh local produce in The Chefs Garden. Discover his favorite recipes, from homemade Italian gnocchi to fresh ocean abalone, highlighting the islands rich culinary treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬西莫走訪工廠與農田,揭開塔斯馬尼亞起司,橄欖與農園新鮮作物的美味秘訣.隨後,他展現高超廚藝,打造出從前菜到麵食的三道精緻義式佳餚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massimo visits factories and farmlands to reveal the secrets behind Tasmanian cheeses, olives, and garden-fresh produce. He then demonstrates his culinary skills by making three delicious Italian dishes, from appetizers to pasta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點,五香牛肉炸角,泰式雞翼和燒牛扒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.
